title: Sandwich Club
question: Is this a sandwich?
scope: Judge each food as shown. Your definition is the one being tested.

cases.label: A cheeseburger
cases.body: A beef patty and cheese between two separate halves of a bread bun.

scene.alt: A cheeseburger between two bread bun halves.

cases.label: A hot dog in a connected bun
cases.body: The bun is split open but still joined along one side.

scene.alt: A hot dog in a bun connected along one side.

cases.label: The same hot dog, bun cut apart
cases.body: Everything stays the same. The bun is now two separate pieces.

scene.alt: The identical hot dog with its bun separated into two pieces.

mutation.changeLabel: The bun is cut completely apart.

cases.label: Ice cream between two cookies
cases.body: Two flat cookies with a layer of ice cream between them.

cases.label: A plain cheese sandwich
cases.body: Cheese between two bread slices, lying flat on a plate.

scene.alt: The identical cheese sandwich rotated onto its side.

cases.label: Sausage in the burger's bun
cases.body: Replace the burger patty with a sausage. Keep everything else.

scene.alt: The original burger bun and cheese with sausage instead of a patty.

cases.label: Jam between the same cookies
cases.body: Replace the ice cream with jam. Keep the cookies.

scene.alt: Jam between the same two cookies.

cases.label: Toast between two bread slices
cases.body: A slice of toast is the filling. The outer slices are untoasted.

scene.alt: Toast between two untoasted bread slices.

cases.label: The cut bun, pushed back together
cases.body: The bun halves touch again. They are still separate pieces.

scene.alt: The cut hot-dog bun pushed together along its seam.

cases.label: Ice cream between bread slices
cases.body: Replace the cookies with bread. Keep the ice cream.

scene.alt: Ice cream between two slices of bread.

cases.label: A square of lasagna
cases.body: Pasta sheets with meat, cheese and sauce between them.

comparisons.headline: One cut changed the call.
comparisons.line: Same food. Connected bun: no. Cut bun: yes.

comparisons.headline: The cut went the other way.
comparisons.line: Same food. Connected bun: yes. Cut bun: no.

comparisons.headline: The sandwich turned. Your call did too.
Cookies got in. The burger didn't.
comparisons.line: Different foods. Keep these calls or change one.

receiptRules.headline: One cut. Full sandwich citizenship.
receiptRules.line: The connected bun was out. The cut bun got in.

receiptRules.headline: Evicted by a bread knife.
receiptRules.line: The connected bun got in. The cut bun was out.

receiptRules.headline: Orientation check failed.
receiptRules.line: The flat cheese sandwich got in. The sideways one did not.

receiptRules.headline: Please rotate your sandwich.
receiptRules.line: The flat one was out. The sideways one got in.

receiptRules.headline: The cookie club rejected the burger.
receiptRules.line: Ice cream between cookies got in. The burger did not.

receiptFallback.headline: Your sandwich club has spoken.
receiptFallback.line: Eight calls recorded. The group chat can take it from here.
